debug_op_call_llm: call debug_op to send buggy code and execution output to an LLM for debugging assistance
debug_op_with_memory: call debug_op with a memory callback to include prior context when debugging code
debug_op_with_data_preview: call debug_op with a data preview string to help the LLM understand input data
debug_op_check_remaining: call debug_op to pass remaining time and step count for time-aware debugging decisions
debug_op_shuffle_packages: call debug_op to automatically shuffle and format available packages for the LLM context
